newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN'S HUBCO EASES ON PROFIT-TAKING.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN'S HUBCO EASES ON PROFIT-TAKING.

text.p: Pakistan's private Hub Power Co Ltd (Hubco) stock eased 0.30 rupee to 55.60 on profit-taking on Friday, a day after it announced a net profit of 7.34 billion rupees for the year ended June 30, dealers said.
Short-term investors sold the 10-rupee shares and booked profits, apparently disappointed that Hubco announced no dividend despite a good corporate result, a dealer said.
Hubco has said it plans to announce an interim dividend during the first quarter of 1998.
Some four million Hubco shares changed hands in early trade at the Karachi stock exchange.
